# Reality Ledger

**Generated by `bin/render-reality-ledger.py --write` from

this page is rendered from: a concept is `available` or `beta` only when a
claim that proves it passed on a sweep, a concept a customer cannot reach
carries no control, and no customer sentence below uses a word the release
may not use. `not_offered` means cut by decision, not postponed;
`not_metered` means nothing reads it.

<a id="accounts"></a>

## Accounts

`accounts` · **planned** · since Session 36

**What a customer reads.** Not open yet. Accounts will be created by invitation only; there is no public signup.

**Today.** A project's auth service holds people and their sessions for that one project. No account spans projects, and nothing outside a project's own auth service knows who a person is.

**Stage 5.** An account in the control project, created when a person accepts an invitation an owner or admin minted and handed over (D1951).

**Eventually (not promised).** Self-service signup with verified email.

<a id="organizations"></a>

## Organizations

`organizations` · **planned** · since Session 36

**What a customer reads.** Not open yet. An organization will group people and projects, with the roles owner, admin, member and viewer.

**Today.** There is no organization. The operator holds every project.

**Stage 5.** Organizations and memberships in the control project's own migration set; TOTP required for owners and admins.

**Eventually (not promised).** Organizations with single sign-on and audit export.

<a id="api_keys"></a>

## Management API keys

`api_keys` · **planned** · since Session 36

**What a customer reads.** Not open yet. A key will authorise management operations only and will never open a database.

**Today.** No management key exists. An agent identity's secret opens that project's agent plane and nothing else.

**Stage 5.** Keys shown once, stored as Argon2id hashes, scoped from a closed vocabulary, owned by a member and revoked with them (D1952).

**Eventually (not promised).** Keys with expiry, rotation reminders and per-key usage.

<a id="management_api"></a>

## Management API (/api/v1)

`management_api` · **planned** · since Session 36

**What a customer reads.** Not open yet.

**Today.** Each project serves its own routes; nothing manages projects over HTTP. The operator manages them with bin/ commands over SSH.

**Stage 5.** One management API in the control project's app mode, frozen as a contract and checked like the other four.

**Eventually (not promised).** A versioned public API with published client libraries.

<a id="cli_remote"></a>

## CLI against the hosted service

`cli_remote` · **planned** · since Session 36

**What a customer reads.** Not open yet. The apg command will sign in and act through the management API only.

**Today.** apg is a dispatcher over the checkout's bin/ commands, run on the host or against a local development cluster.

**Stage 5.** New verbs (login, logout, context, org, project) that are clients of /api/v1; later sessions add branch, backup, compute, usage and plan.

**Eventually (not promised).** The same, plus completion and a published binary.

<a id="console"></a>

## Web console

`console` · **planned** · since Session 36

**What a customer reads.** Not open yet.

**Today.** There is no web console. Studio is a loopback page an operator or developer runs locally against one project.

**Stage 5.** Static pages served by the control project, calling /api/v1 only, with no SQL tab; project views open that project's own Studio forwarders.

**Eventually (not promised).** A full web console with in-browser data tools.

<a id="projects_self_service"></a>

## Create a project

`projects_self_service` · **planned** · since Session 36

**What a customer reads.** Not open yet. Creating a project will be refused with "capacity exhausted" when this server has no room, and nothing will be created.

**Today.** The operator creates a project by writing a manifest and running the deploy as root; admission refuses a project that does not fit the declared host (exit 12).

**Stage 5.** project.create as an operation the reconciler executes into a prepared slot, through the same admission and deploy.

**Eventually (not promised).** Placement across a fleet of servers.

*API operations:* `project.create` -- refused (`409 not_available`) until this concept is available or in beta.

<a id="project_deletion"></a>

## Delete a project

`project_deletion` · **planned** · since Session 36

**What a customer reads.** Not open yet.

**Today.** The operator retires a project with bin/project-retire.sh, which removes only what the project's names derive.

**Stage 5.** project.delete as an operation (D1972).

**Eventually (not promised).** The same, with a grace period and recovery.

*API operations:* `project.delete` -- refused (`409 not_available`) until this concept is available or in beta.

<a id="export"></a>

## Export a project

`export` · **planned** · since Session 36

**What a customer reads.** Not open yet.

**Today.** The operator can take a backup and run a restore drill; there is no export a customer downloads.

**Stage 5.** project.export as an operation producing an archive (D1972).

**Eventually (not promised).** Scheduled exports to a customer's own storage.

*API operations:* `project.export` -- refused (`409 not_available`) until this concept is available or in beta.

<a id="region"></a>

## Region

`region` · **planned** · since Session 36

**What a customer reads.** Every project runs in one location, the one server this beta runs on.

**Today.** One server in one Hetzner location. The host manifest does not name a region.

**Stage 5.** A host.yaml field read everywhere, with one value (D1957).

**Eventually (not promised).** Placement across locations.

<a id="compute_profiles"></a>

## Compute size

`compute_profiles` · **planned** · since Session 36

**What a customer reads.** Not open yet. Changing a project's size will restart it, and the message will say how long the restart was measured to take.

**Today.** Memory, process and CPU limits per service come from release defaults a manifest can override for memory and pool size; there is no named size.

**Stage 5.** Named profiles in a release file, selected in the manifest, changed by project.resize with the measured window (D1955).

**Eventually (not promised).** Compute scheduled independently of storage.

*API operations:* `project.resize` -- refused (`409 not_available`) until this concept is available or in beta.

<a id="sleep"></a>

## Sleep and wake

`sleep` · **planned** · since Session 36

**What a customer reads.** Not open yet.

**Today.** Nothing sleeps. A project's containers run until the operator stops them.

**Stage 5.** project.sleep and project.wake stop and start the project's containers, volumes kept; what a caller sees while it sleeps is measured first (D1956).

**Eventually (not promised).** Compute suspended and resumed independently of storage.

*API operations:* `project.sleep`, `project.wake` -- refused (`409 not_available`) until this concept is available or in beta.

<a id="pooled_endpoint"></a>

## Pooled connection string

`pooled_endpoint` · **planned** · since Session 36

**What a customer reads.** Not open yet.

**Today.** There is no public Postgres endpoint. The operator reaches a project's pooler through an SSH forward.

**Stage 5.** A TLS endpoint per project on the edge, routed to the project's PgBouncer, plaintext refused (ADR 0246's one Postgres port).

**Eventually (not promised).** The same, behind a fleet-wide gateway.

<a id="direct_endpoint"></a>

## Direct connection string

`direct_endpoint` · **planned** · since Session 36

**What a customer reads.** Not open yet.

**Today.** There is no public Postgres endpoint. The operator reaches a project's database through an SSH forward.

**Stage 5.** A TLS endpoint per project routed to the database for migrations, used by the customer_admin role.

**Eventually (not promised).** The same, behind a fleet-wide gateway.

*API operations:* `credential.rotate` -- refused (`409 not_available`) until this concept is available or in beta.

<a id="wake_on_connect"></a>

## Wake on connect

`wake_on_connect` · **planned** · since Session 36

**What a customer reads.** Not open yet.

**Today.** Nothing sleeps, so nothing wakes.

**Stage 5.** Built only if Session 39's gateway rig shows a connection can be held while a project starts; otherwise it stays planned (D1956).

**Eventually (not promised).** A connection that wakes a sleeping project transparently.

<a id="branches"></a>

## Branches

`branches` · **planned** · since Session 36

**What a customer reads.** Not open yet. A branch will be a full copy restored from backups, so creating one will take time in proportion to the project's size.

**Today.** The operator's restore drill restores a project at a point in time into a disposable volume and deletes it.

**Stage 5.** branch.create restores the parent's repository at a target time into the branch's own names, re-keyed before its endpoint opens (D1961).

**Eventually (not promised).** Storage-native copy-on-write branches.

*API operations:* `branch.create`, `branch.delete`, `branch.reset` -- refused (`409 not_available`) until this concept is available or in beta.

<a id="restore_to_branch"></a>

## Restore to a new branch

`restore_to_branch` · **planned** · since Session 36

**What a customer reads.** Not open yet.

**Today.** The operator restores to a point in time into a disposable volume (the restore drill) or onto a replacement host.

**Stage 5.** restore.create is branch.create with a target time (D1963).

**Eventually (not promised).** The same, faster.

*API operations:* `restore.create` -- refused (`409 not_available`) until this concept is available or in beta.

<a id="in_place_restore"></a>

## Restore a project in place

`in_place_restore` · **not_offered** · since Session 36

**What a customer reads.** Not available, by decision. Restore to a new branch instead; your project is never overwritten by a restore.

**Today.** An in-place restore exists only for the operator onto a replacement host; the restore refuses a volume that holds a cluster.

**Stage 5.** Cut (D1963): a destructive restore is the one action whose failure loses the data the product exists to keep.

**Eventually (not promised).** An in-place restore with a pre-restore snapshot.

<a id="branch_promotion"></a>

## Promote a branch

`branch_promotion` · **not_offered** · since Session 36

**What a customer reads.** Not available, by decision. Apply the change to your main branch as a reviewed migration instead.

**Today.** A change reaches a project as a migration through the proposal record (ADR 0243).

**Stage 5.** Cut (D1962): promotion needs write coordination across two clusters, which nothing here does.

**Eventually (not promised).** Promotion with route cutover and verification.

<a id="query_insights"></a>

## Query Insights

`query_insights` · **planned** · since Session 36

**What a customer reads.** Not open yet.

**Today.** pg_stat_statements is not loaded; no query is recorded.

**Stage 5.** pg_stat_statements loaded, normalised statements served per project, with no recommendation engine (D1965).

**Eventually (not promised).** Longer history and recommendations.

<a id="monitoring"></a>

## Monitoring

`monitoring` · **planned** · since Session 36

**What a customer reads.** Not open yet.

**Today.** Each project has its own collector and Prometheus store, routed nowhere; the operator reads them through doctor.

**Stage 5.** A curated signal list, each naming its source, and ClickStack bounded on the host (D1964).

**Eventually (not promised).** Dashboards and alert routing.

<a id="usage"></a>

## Usage

`usage` · **planned** · since Session 36

**What a customer reads.** Not open yet.

**Today.** doctor usage reads eight figures per project at the moment it is asked; nothing is recorded over time.

**Stage 5.** The reconciler samples each project's readings on an interval; usage is aggregated per project and per organization (D1966).

**Eventually (not promised).** Metered usage that drives billing.

<a id="egress_metering"></a>

## Network egress usage

`egress_metering` · **not_metered** · since Session 36

**What a customer reads.** Not measured. Usage pages will not show network egress, provider calls or embeddings.

**Today.** Nothing reads egress, provider calls or embedding usage.

**Stage 5.** Not metered in Stage 5 (D1966).

**Eventually (not promised).** Metered egress.

<a id="plan_free"></a>

## Free plan

`plan_free` · **planned** · since Session 36

**What a customer reads.** Not open yet. During the beta every project is on the Free plan, at no cost.

**Today.** There are no plans and no entitlements.

**Stage 5.** A release file of plans; the limits enforced are the ones an existing mechanism can enforce (D1967).

**Eventually (not promised).** The same.

<a id="plan_premium"></a>

## Premium plan

`plan_premium` · **planned** · since Session 36

**What a customer reads.** Defined but not available during the beta. You can ask to be told when it is.

**Today.** There are no plans.

**Stage 5.** Defined and shown as unavailable; "Notify me" records interest (D1967).

**Eventually (not promised).** A paid plan.

<a id="notifications"></a>

## Notifications

`notifications` · **planned** · since Session 36

**What a customer reads.** Not open yet. Notifications will be shown in the console only.

**Today.** Nothing notifies anyone.

**Stage 5.** A table and a list route (D1968).

**Eventually (not promised).** In-app, email and webhook notifications.

<a id="email"></a>

## Email

`email` · **planned** · since Session 36

**What a customer reads.** This beta sends no email. Invitations and password resets are handed to you by the person who issued them.

**Today.** Nothing sends email. A password-reset token is issued by an administrator and handed over out of band.

**Stage 5.** Not built in Stage 5 (D1951).

**Eventually (not promised).** Transactional email.

<a id="passkeys"></a>

## Passkeys

`passkeys` · **planned** · since Session 36

**What a customer reads.** Not available yet. Owners and admins will use a password and a one-time code.

**Today.** There are no passkeys and no second factor.

**Stage 5.** Not built in Stage 5; TOTP is (D1951).

**Eventually (not promised).** Passkeys for every role.

<a id="sql_editor"></a>

## SQL editor

`sql_editor` · **not_offered** · since Session 36

**What a customer reads.** Not available, by decision. Connect with psql or your own client through your project's direct connection string.

**Today.** No product surface runs SQL (ADR 0246).

**Stage 5.** Cut (D1969); the Connect page shows a psql snippet instead.

**Eventually (not promised).** A browser SQL editor acting as the person, never a shared credential.

<a id="support_access"></a>

## Temporary support access

`support_access` · **not_offered** · since Session 36

**What a customer reads.** The operator of this single node has root on it; support access is not technically bounded in this beta.

**Today.** The operator holds root. The standing read-only path is apg-diag behind one SSH key, with no lifetime.

**Stage 5.** Grants are not built (D1971); a support bundle a member downloads is.

**Eventually (not promised).** Time-bounded, audited support grants.

<a id="autoscaling"></a>

## Autoscaling

`autoscaling` · **not_offered** · since Session 36

**What a customer reads.** Not available. A project's size changes only when you resize it, and a resize restarts it.

**Today.** Nothing changes a project's size on its own.

**Stage 5.** Not built (product contract §5, ADR 0246).

**Eventually (not promised).** Compute that grows and shrinks with load.

<a id="high_availability"></a>

## High availability

`high_availability` · **not_offered** · since Session 36

**What a customer reads.** Not available. Every project runs on one server; if it fails, your project is down until it is restored from backup.

**Today.** One server. Recovery from its loss is a restore from backups onto a replacement host.

**Stage 5.** Not built (product contract §5, ADR 0246).

**Eventually (not promised).** Replicas and automatic failover.

<a id="multi_region"></a>

## Multiple regions

`multi_region` · **not_offered** · since Session 36

**What a customer reads.** Not available. Every project runs in one location.

**Today.** One server in one location.

**Stage 5.** Not built (product contract §5, ADR 0246).

**Eventually (not promised).** Projects placed and replicated across locations.

<a id="sla"></a>

## Service level agreement

`sla` · **not_offered** · since Session 36

**What a customer reads.** Not available. This beta carries no uptime commitment.

**Today.** Nothing measures or promises uptime.

**Stage 5.** Not offered in Stage 5.

**Eventually (not promised).** A measured, contractual service level.

<a id="billing"></a>

## Billing

`billing` · **not_offered** · since Session 36

**What a customer reads.** Not available. The beta is free and takes no payment details.

**Today.** Nothing charges anyone.

**Stage 5.** No checkout, invoice, card form or tax field (D1967).

**Eventually (not promised).** Payments and invoicing.

<a id="postgresql"></a>

## PostgreSQL

`postgresql` · **planned** · since Session 36

**What a customer reads.** Not open yet. Projects will run PostgreSQL 18 with pgvector.

**Today.** Every project runs the locked PostgreSQL 18.4 image, with pgvector in the extensions schema.

*Proved by:* `database_extensions`.

**Stage 5.** The same cluster per project, reachable by a customer through the Session 39 endpoints.

**Eventually (not promised).** The same, with a choice of major version.

<a id="project_isolation"></a>

## Project isolation

`project_isolation` · **planned** · since Session 36

**What a customer reads.** Not open yet. Each project will have its own database cluster, roles, network, volumes and credentials; projects on the server share only the edge that routes requests.

**Today.** Two projects on one host share exactly the edge; the isolation matrix compares every project-scoped name in their deployed documents.

*Proved by:* `isolation_matrix`.

**Stage 5.** The same isolation for every project the reconciler creates.

**Eventually (not promised).** Isolation across servers as well.

<a id="backups_and_pitr"></a>

## Backups and point-in-time recovery

`backups_and_pitr` · **planned** · since Session 36

**What a customer reads.** Not open yet. Backups are continuous to off-site object storage, with a nightly copy to a second provider.

**Today.** pgBackRest archives each project to R2 with a nightly B2 mirror; a timestamp-targeted restore into a disposable volume succeeds.

*Proved by:* `point_in_time_recovery`.

**Stage 5.** The doctor's backup readings served through /api/v1, the restore window computed from pgBackRest, never declared (D1963).

**Eventually (not promised).** More redundancy and faster restores.

<a id="agents"></a>

## Agents (MCP)

`agents` · **planned** · since Session 36

**What a customer reads.** Not open yet.

**Today.** Each project serves an agent plane: tools compiled into a lock, scoped identities, budgets, approvals, idempotency and an audit record.

*Proved by:* `agent_surface`.

**Stage 5.** Every project the reconciler creates carries its agent plane; the console opens it through the project's Studio forwarders.

**Eventually (not promised).** The same.

<a id="workflows"></a>

## Workflows

`workflows` · **planned** · since Session 36

**What a customer reads.** Not open yet.

**Today.** Each project runs reviewed workflows as its agents, with approvals, compensation and provenance, in a worker inside its auth service.

*Proved by:* `workflow_run`.

**Stage 5.** Every project the reconciler creates carries them; the console reaches them through Studio forwarders (D1970).

**Eventually (not promised).** The same.

<a id="connectors"></a>

## Connectors

`connectors` · **planned** · since Session 36

**What a customer reads.** Not open yet.

**Today.** A project with the connectors facility delivers signed events out, accepts signed requests in and runs workflows on a schedule.

*Proved by:* `connector_delivery_live`.

**Stage 5.** Every project the reconciler creates can enable them; the console reaches them through Studio forwarders (D1970).

**Eventually (not promised).** The same.

<a id="audit"></a>

## Audit log

`audit` · **planned** · since Session 36

**What a customer reads.** Not open yet.

**Today.** Every agent call is recorded before and after its work, a denial included, and kept until an operator prunes it on a stated horizon.

*Proved by:* `agent_audit_record`.

**Stage 5.** Every project the reconciler creates carries it; the console reaches it through Studio forwarders.

**Eventually (not promised).** Audit export to a customer's own storage.
